main.description: A self-declared opt-out from standard incite's results, written by the account itself — not by whoever searched for it. Anyone's moots pool can surface anyone else, but only the account's own repo can hold a valid opt-out for itself, so this is the one record kind that respects self-removal without requiring cooperation from whoever ran the search. A single fixed record key ("self") per repo; standard incite drops any mutual with a live opt-out record on their own repo from every result, regardless of who searched or how stale their publications are. Written and read by standard incite (https://standard-incite.bisks.net).

subject.description: Must equal the DID of the repo this record lives in — an opt-out only ever applies to its own author.

optedOutAt.description: When this opt-out was written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
